capabilities: Complete ##tag names from the current file with substring or prefix matching
Browse and filter the current note's tags in a hierarchical panel
Navigate tag occurrences via click-to-search and Shift+click cycling
Attach descriptions and per-note colors to tags under a local-tags-config section
Adjust shared tag appearance such as text color, background, and emphasis
disambiguation: Not a replacement for standard #tags; it adds a separate file-local vocabulary written with ## that is unrelated to vault tag indexing.
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.14.4 or later; the project does not accept pull requests and ongoing maintenance is not guaranteed. Recognition in languages other than English and Japanese is unverified.
intentEvidence: Standard #tags are indexed across the vault. Local ##tags have a separate vocabulary in each file.
problem: Standard Obsidian tags are indexed vault-wide, so the same tag name shares one vocabulary and suggestion list across all notes.
summary: Adds file-local ##tags with per-note completion, descriptions, decoration, and a hierarchical tag panel for the current note.
